audience: UK landlords and self-employed people who keep their tax records in Quarterwise

useCases.title: See all your properties and businesses
useCases.text: List the income sources of the account with the type, the share and the number of transactions.

useCases.title: Review the expenses of one property
useCases.text: List the entries of a property in a date range. Ask the assistant to total the expenses by category.

useCases.title: Check the valid HMRC category keys
useCases.text: Read the category keys for a UK property, an overseas property or a business. Use them to label entries correctly.

useCases.title: Import rent payments from a spreadsheet
useCases.text: Add many rent payments to the ledger of a property in one call. Each entry has a unique reference, so a retry adds nothing twice.
